known_deltas: Threshold audit (step 0.3, 2026-10-14): v3.0 literals captured in config.legacy_verification with IDENTICAL defaults — cross-lingual 0.65; risk bands 0.15/0.35/0.60; consistency/grounding weights 0.5/0.5; similarity levels 0.85/0.65/0.45. No divergent hardcodes vs new agent thresholds (0.85/0.75/0.60) — no conflicts, stop-point not triggered.
Contract refinements (pre-0.3): log_event gained optional trace_id (None default, backward compatible); metrics.snapshot gained avg_time_per_atom_local / avg_time_per_atom_network.

LLM inventory (step 0.4 stop-point #1): ALL v3.0 LLM calls go through DeepSeekClient (extractor/generator/verification/translator/image_gen/demo/__init__). Direct requests use is only image_gen.py (Flux image API — not LLM). No hidden LLM call sites; facade covers 100%.
_call_json failure channel preserved (v3.0 compat): unrepairable JSON returns {"raw_response": ..., "parse_error": "unrepairable JSON"} (not an exception) + llm_json_parse_failed log event.

Retry-After support (0.4 refine, curator #1): retry delay = max(backoff, Retry-After header) when present. llm_call now logs attempts + retries; latency_ms = wall-time of ALL attempts incl. backoff sleeps (documented in AGENTS.md, curator #5).

Extractor parse_error guard (0.4 refine, curator #3): on unrepairable JSON extractor logs extract_structure_parse_error and falls back to rule-based structure (no silent empty result). Remaining _call_json consumers (verification paths) audited at 1.3 rewrite / 1.4 demo.

Wikidata schema live-check (1.1 stop-point, 2026-10-14): NO drift. wbsearchentities hit = {id,label,description,match{type,language,text},pageid,concepturi,title,repository,url,display} (no aliases in hit); wbgetentities top = {entities, success}; entity keys = {aliases, claims, descriptions, id, labels, sitelinks, type}; redirects field absent on normal fetch (parser handles list[{from,to}] AND dict{old:new}); API errors return HTTP 200 with {"error":{"code","info"}} e.g. no-such-entity.
backlog: LLM retry jitter (+/-20%) — curator 0.4 note #2; apply at 1.4+ when concurrent atoms grow (thundering herd).
